name: Tai Industries Limited
summary: TAI Industries Ltd. engages in the trading, marketing, distribution, and retailing of fruit and mineral products. It operates through the DRUK brand of fruit products, such as squashes, jam, fruit juices, pickles, and ketchup. The firm also carries on trading and marketing of industrial and mineral products and raw materials, which include calcium carbide, charcoal, and manganese ore. TAI Industries was founded by Dasho Ugen Dorji on May 5, 1983 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
